source_text: Expoliatus tunica, missus in cisternam vacuam. Descensus animae vel Christi ad inferiora.
pass_a_gloss: Stripped of-tunic, sent into cistern empty. Descent of-soul or of-Christ to lower-parts.
pass_b_english: [[Stripped of the tunic, cast into an empty cistern >> Bible:Genesis 37:23-24]]. Descent of the soul — or of Christ — to the lower parts.
